Title: Instrument MemorySmith domain operations with ActivitySource and Meter.
Description: Add MemorySmith domain telemetry for key operations (search modes, context pack generation, create/update/delete) using a dedicated ActivitySource and Meter. Metrics should include operation counts, failure counts, and duration histograms with bounded dimensions. Acceptance criteria: domain operation telemetry is emitted for critical flows, tags remain low-cardinality, benchmark/logging behavior remains compatible, and admin-configurable toggles can disable domain instrumentation when needed.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Domain-instrumentation task covers custom ActivitySource/Meter plus critical MemoryApplicationService flow coverage.
